title: Turbomachinery
description: Introduction to basics of theory, design, analysis, and selection of turbomachinery. Turbomachines are widely used in myriad engineering applications such as energy conversion, HVAC, and propulsion, in the forms of pumps, compressors, gas turbines, jet engines, wind turbines, etc. Variety of such applications used as examples to illustrate important concepts
